parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID for which you want to query high-precision second-level monitoring.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description: The type of the instance. Set the value to **EIP**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the instance.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~448570~~) operation to query the region ID.
